summary.id: Hawazan melawan koalisi pimpinan GIE. Perundingan damai gagal 1 Nov, Hawazan mengklaim menang 2 Nov (belum diverifikasi), dan UDC bubar 3 Nov. Koalisi kini pecah: AOCTL dikeluarkan lalu berbalik melawan GIE, dan SDU mundur setelah satu pertempuran terakhir 7 Nov. Sekutu Hawazan, BCC, tutup 6 Nov.
summary.en: Hawazan against a GIE-led coalition. Peace talks failed on 1 Nov, Hawazan claimed victory on 2 Nov (unverified), and the UDC disbanded on 3 Nov. The coalition is now splitting: AOCTL was expelled and turned on GIE, and SDU leaves after one last battle on 7 Nov. Hawazan's ally BCC shut down on 6 Nov.

note.id: Sekutu sejak 1 Nov; tutup 6 Nov setelah ownernya keluar
note.en: Ally since 1 Nov; shut down on 6 Nov after its owner quit

note.id: Pendiri dan pemimpin koalisi; diserang sejak 16 Okt, menurut GIE
note.en: Coalition founder and leader; attacked since 16 Oct, per GIE

note.id: Sempat mundur 28 Okt, diserang balik 29 Okt
Keluar dari koalisi 4 Nov; mundur total setelah pertempuran terakhir 7 Nov 19.00
note.en: Left the coalition on 4 Nov; withdraws fully after a last battle on 7 Nov 19:00

note.id: Dikeluarkan dari koalisi 4 Nov, lalu menyatakan perang ke GIE
note.en: Expelled from the coalition on 4 Nov, then declared war on GIE
Withdrew and dissolved its coalition on 28 Oct
Withdrew 28 Oct, threatened to return on 30 Oct
Made peace with Hawazan on 1 Nov

text.id: NATO menyatakan perang terhadap Hawazan.

text.en: Hawazan gives AOCTL a 12-hour ultimatum.

text.en: Hawazan allies with Black Cat Central V2.

text.en: SDU and the coalition refuse peace talks.

text.id: AOCTL menolak ultimatum: "Bring it on."
text.en: AOCTL rejects the ultimatum: "Bring it on."

text.id: Hawazan dan AOCTL saling menyalahkan atas gagalnya perundingan.

text.id: UDC bubar untuk rebranding.

text.en: GIE expels two factions from the coalition, one of them AOCTL.

text.id: Pidato Hitler diputar di rapat UN; TIC menuduh anggota Hawazan neo-Nazi dan melakukan pelecehan.
text.en: A Hitler speech is played at the UN meeting; TIC accuses Hawazan members of neo-Nazism and harassment.

text.id: Pendiri GIE menuduh Menlu Hawazan menyebar klaim tanpa bukti; Hawazan disebut menolak bersekutu dengan AOCTL.
text.en: GIE's founder accuses Hawazan's foreign minister of unproven claims; Hawazan reportedly refused an alliance with AOCTL.

text.id: BCC, sekutu Hawazan, tutup setelah ownernya keluar.
text.en: BCC, Hawazan's ally, shuts down after its owner quits.

summary.id: Black Cat Central (BCC) sempat berperang dengan belasan faksi, puncaknya 16 faksi sekaligus pada 4 Nov. Pada 6 Nov ownernya keluar dan BCC praktis tutup; anggotanya diminta pindah ke 5V Allied Powers.
summary.en: Black Cat Central (BCC) fought a dozen-plus factions, peaking at 16 at once on 4 Nov. On 6 Nov its owner quit and BCC effectively shut down; members were told to move to the 5V Allied Powers.

note.en: Shut down on 6 Nov after its owner quit

note.id: Perang penuh sejak 27 Okt; BCC mengaku menyusupkan mata-mata
note.en: Full-scale war since 27 Oct; BCC claims it planted a spy

note.id: Menyatakan perang 1 Nov, didukung British Empire, Russian Bears dan Colgate Crest
note.en: Declared war on 1 Nov, backed by the British Empire, Russian Bears and Colgate Crest
Ended the alliance, then attacked on 27 Oct

note.id: Diserang 30 Okt, masuk daftar 16 faksi 4 Nov, lalu dinyatakan perang lagi malamnya
note.en: Targeted 30 Oct, on the 16-faction list on 4 Nov, then declared on again that night

note.id: Mundur 1 Nov karena salah sasaran, diserang lagi 4 Nov

Joined to defend allies on 26 Oct

text.id: WDU menyatakan perang terhadap BCC.
text.en: WDU declares war on BCC.

text.id: GAE menyatakan perang terhadap BCC.

text.id: SDU mundur dari perang melawan BCC.

text.en: TIC declares total war on BCC.

text.en: BCC declares war on 16 factions at once.

text.en: CANZUK refuses to fight BCC and calls for peace.

text.id: UN akan dibubarkan karena tidak melapor insiden rapat ke Slop Company.
text.en: The UN will be disbanded for not reporting the meeting incident to Slop Company.

summary.id: Setelah dikeluarkan dari koalisi, Army of Christ Our Lord menyatakan perang ke GIE dan mengajak TIC serta Hawazan bersekutu. Menurut GIE, Hawazan sudah menolak ajakan AOCTL.
summary.en: After being expelled from the coalition, Army of Christ Our Lord declared war on GIE and invited TIC and Hawazan to ally with it. According to GIE, Hawazan already turned AOCTL down.

text.id: GIE mengeluarkan AOCTL dari koalisi.
text.en: GIE expels AOCTL from the coalition.

text.en: AOCTL declares war on GIE.

summary.id: GOC, yang sedang ditinggal banyak anggotanya, kini dikeroyok dari beberapa arah. TPE menyatakan perang 4 Nov karena GOC menyerang anggota netral, padahal keduanya sama-sama di koalisi melawan Hawazan. Menurut BCBN, GOC juga berperang dengan 5V Allied Powers dan GAE.
summary.en: GOC, already losing many members, is now under pressure from several sides. TPE declared war on 4 Nov after GOC attacked a neutral member, even though both are in the coalition against Hawazan. Per BCBN, GOC is also at war with the 5V Allied Powers and GAE.

note.id: Lebih dari 34 anggota keluar minggu ini

summary.en: TIC declared total war on The Phoenician Empire, accusing TPE of ambushing and harassing its members. TPE denies it and calls TIC hypocritical for claiming neutrality at the UN.
